formulas.total_operating_expenses: compensation_and_benefits + transaction_based + market_development + communications_and_technology + depreciation_and_amortization + occupancy + professional_fees + other_expenses

investment_banking_yoy.description: Investment banking revenue YoY growth rate vs Q-4

investment_management_yoy.description: Investment management revenue YoY growth rate vs Q-4

commissions_and_fees_yoy.description: Commissions and fees revenue YoY growth rate vs Q-4

trading_revenue_yoy.description: Combined market making and other principal transactions revenue YoY growth rate vs Q-4

net_interest_margin_delta_bps.description: Net interest income (interest income minus interest expense) as % of total net revenues, delta vs Q-4

total_operating_expenses_margin_delta_bp.description: Total operating expenses as % of total net revenues, delta vs Q-4

provision_for_credit_losses_abs.description: provision_for_credit_losses absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.

preferred_stock_dividends_abs.description: preferred_stock_dividends absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).
